celltostars.hud.evolve_ready: Ready to evolve! Call a mate [%s] - evolve in the editor
celltostars.part.flagellum.desc: Each flagellum makes you swim a bit faster (up to 5)
celltostars.part.spike.desc: Hurts every creature you touch; more spikes = more damage (up to 3)
celltostars.editor.title: Cell Editor
celltostars.editor.diet.desc: Herbivore (filter feelers) eats plants. Carnivore (pincers) eats meat and swallows small cells whole. Omnivore (proboscis) eats plants and sucks juice from living cells.
celltostars.msg.start: You are a tiny cell in the primordial soup. Eat to grow!
celltostars.msg.ready: Your cell is ready to evolve!
celltostars.msg.evolved: Your creature crawls onto land! (The creature stage is coming soon)
celltostars.msg.no_dimension: The primordial soup world was not found
celltostars.editor.title_resume: Your cell is waiting in its egg
celltostars.editor.name: Name
celltostars.msg.mate_called: A mate is waiting for you - follow the waves!
celltostars.editor.rotate_hint: Hold the left mouse button and drag to turn your cell
celltostars.editor.evolve.desc: Leave the water and become a creature. Or hatch once more to keep buying parts.
celltostars.editor.need_name: Give your creature a name first
celltostars.msg.grew: Your cell grew! Size %s/%s - the soup around you changes...
celltostars.options.window.desc: Borderless looks like fullscreen, but Alt+Tab is instant. Saved for the next start.
celltostars.msg.path: Your cell stage made you a %s. Creature-stage ability: %s
